about: The way to the village across the river: point_to draws the particle trail and the boss bar's arrow; the shot looks along the trail.

answer.en: Follow the cherry petals across the river: the village is &6100&r blocks south-east. The bar on top turns with you.
answer.ru: Иди по лепесткам через реку: до деревни &6100&r блоков на юго-восток. Стрелка сверху поворачивается вместе с тобой.
answer.es: Sigue los pétalos al otro lado del río: la aldea está a &6100&r bloques al sureste. La barra de arriba gira contigo.
